title: Who left these tracks on the roof? 👣 #shorts
description: True story: Devon, England, 9 February 1855. After a snowfall, a line of hoof-shaped prints ran over walls and roofs through town after town. No one ever saw what made them. Full true story on the channel. #shorts #truestory #unsolvedmystery #devilsfootprints #hollowmere

beats.en: True story. Devon, 1855. Hoof prints in the snow, one single line.
beats.es: Historia real. Devon, 1855. Huellas de pezuña en la nieve, en una sola fila.
beats.de: Wahre Geschichte. Devon, 1855. Hufspuren im Schnee, in einer einzigen Linie.
beats.fr: Histoire vraie. Devon, 1855. Des traces de sabot dans la neige, en une seule ligne.
beats.it: Storia vera. Devon, 1855. Impronte di zoccolo nella neve, in un'unica fila.
beats.pt: História real. Devon, 1855. Pegadas de casco na neve, numa fila só.

beats.en: They went up walls. Over the rooftops. Through town after town.
beats.es: Subían muros. Sobre los tejados. Pueblo tras pueblo.
beats.de: Sie gingen Mauern hinauf. Über die Dächer. Durch Ort um Ort.
beats.fr: Elles montaient les murs. Sur les toits. De ville en ville.
beats.it: Salivano sui muri. Sopra i tetti. Paese dopo paese.
beats.pt: Subiam muros. Pelos telhados. Cidade após cidade.

beats.en: No one ever saw what made them.
beats.es: Nadie vio nunca qué las hizo.
beats.de: Niemand sah je, was sie machte.
beats.fr: Personne n'a jamais vu ce qui les a faites.
beats.it: Nessuno vide mai cosa le fece.
beats.pt: Ninguém jamais viu o que as fez.

beats.en: Something walked through town last night...
beats.de: Etwas ging letzte Nacht durch den Ort...
beats.fr: Quelque chose a traversé la ville cette nuit...
beats.it: Qualcosa ha attraversato il paese stanotte...
beats.pt: Algo atravessou a cidade ontem à noite...
